name: Cropster Agro Limited
about: Cropster Agro Limited engages in trading of agriculture products in India. It trades in palm olein oil, sunflower refined oil, refined palm olein, castor, cotton seed refined oil, palm oil, refined soya oil, rice bran oil, mustard expeller oil, and sugar products. The company was formerly known as Planter's Polysacks Limited and changed its name to Cropster Agro Limited in July 2023. Cropster Agro Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
